note: 0xa3 row: 'c v -> c'; v popped first; v clamped: (uint32)v > 255 -> 255; c' = c with bits 7..0 <- v; pushed as 0x15'. (uint32)-2 > 255, so a negative clamps to 255 (a mask & 0xff would give 0xfe): 0x11223344 with the alpha channel <- 0xff = 0x112233ff.
